t: Naming a newborn after someone you loved
a: تَدْمَعُ الْعَيْنُ وَيَحْزَنُ الْقَلْبُ وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا وَاللَّهِ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِنَّا بِكَ لَمَحْزُونُونَ
m: A child was born to me tonight and I have named him after my father, Ibrāhīm. Then when the child was dying he said: the eye weeps and the heart grieves, and we do not say except what pleases our Lord. And we are grieved at parting from you, Ibrāhīm.
